about: Town projects (Docs/Design/57-changing-the-world.md, 4): public works a town needs, built from materials, labour and coin, standing as structures on the Chapters' layer (never terrain) and changing the simulation while they stand. Each kind: its name, the structure it becomes ("" for a mending, which stands as nothing), its title ({town}: the town's name), the materials it needs (catalog ids), the work-hours, how fast it wears a game day, the two roles workers take, and whether only a city has one. `perTown`/`perCity`: open projects at once; `lapseDays`: an unfinished project is cancelled and its gifts returned after so long; `hourShare`: a work-hour is worth this share of the town's labourer's day on the plaque; `name`: a project is named for its chief giver at this share of a whole worth this much; `upkeepUnder`: its leftover coin mends it below this condition; `deeds`: the chief giver's is notable (great at `greatWorth` or more), others who gave `otherShare` or more, small; `hands`: each resident hand's spell counts so many work-hours, so many hands a day at most. Every number is a placeholder.
